requirement_understanding: The Product Type Master module within the Ambica Enterprise ERP platform allows authorized master data managers to manage the taxonomy of product types. The module provides full CRUD capabilities (Create, Read/View, Update, Delete) along with status toggling (Active/Inactive) to organize product catalog categories effectively.
requirement_gaps: Exact minimum and maximum character length constraints for 'Product Type Name' and 'Description' are not explicitly defined in UI schema.
Handling of duplicate Product Type Names (case-sensitivity rules) is not documented.
Soft-deletion vs hard-deletion rules and cascading dependency effects on existing linked products are unspecified.
business_rules: Product Type Name must be unique across the tenant enterprise database.
Product Type Name is required and cannot be empty or whitespace-only.
Product Type status must default to Active upon creation.
Deleting a Product Type with active child product references must be blocked or prompt a dependency error.
assumptions: User is authenticated with Master Data Administrator privileges.
Application environment is pre-populated with baseline master data tables.
Data table pagination defaults to 10 records per page.
risks: Unvalidated deletion might orphan existing inventory items associated with deleted product types.
Brittle auto-generated selector IDs (e.g., #pn_id_8-table, #pn_id_11) can cause automated test execution failures following minor UI re-renders.

test_strategy.scope_out: Authentication/Login flows, global layout header/footer links, role privilege configuration management.
test_strategy.rollback_plan: Execute automated database teardown scripts post-test execution to remove dummy test records created during test runs.

from playwright.sync_api import Page, expect

def test_product_type_master_crud(page: Page):
    page.goto('https://gc-dev.centralindia.cloudapp.azure.com/ambica/auth/login')
    # Module navigation assuming active session
    page.click('button:has-text("Master Data")')
    page.click('a:has-text("Product Type Master")')
    
    # Add Product Type
    page.click('button:has-text("Add Product Type")')
    page.fill('#productTypeName', 'Automation Category')
    page.fill('#description', 'Created via Playwright test runner')
    page.click('button:has-text("Submit")')
    
    # Verification
    expect(page.locator('table')).to_contain_text('Automation Category')
